units.source_text: 古歌：“与尔相邻近，似形随影然。

en.t: An old poem says: "Living so close beside you, I am like a shadow following its form.

units.source_text: 无缘相探访，谁设勿来关？”见《后撰集》。

en.t: Yet with no chance to visit one another, who was it that set up the barrier of Nakoso?" It appears in the Later Collection of Japanese Poems.
The Barrier of Nakoso is a famous scenic place in Mutsu.
